verification.astraReview: completed; declaration-only semantics, descriptor/scope/operation uniqueness, exact sourceRef ordering, fixed head before every publication and exact new-operation readback verified
verification.finalCoverage: 111 complete unchanged old cases plus 24 exact-final new cases; no claim that the last exact-final source ran all six files together

limitations: Observed bytes authenticated means signed retained readback; text is supplied by the caller, not by an authenticated RRSI producer
Preparation association authenticates the retained declaration chain, not causal generation or a fresh budget/execution/settlement verdict
The original graph is fixed; a different genuine backend may create a separate local log but known/unknown queries always remain HOLD, with no tenant-wide uniqueness claim
No candidate alias protocol, Registry content initialization, business writer, release lease or promotion cutover was enabled
In-flight ArtifactPorts publication cannot be revoked by a later ownership/head check; uncertain/orphan artifacts are kept rather than adopted or deleted
Lost-owner injection is at the first policy owner-file read; it verifies the real artifact tree remains unchanged but does not uniquely locate the last pre-publication check
Signed association corruption is internally inconsistent goal metadata, not a complete self-consistent forged History chain attack
No dedicated independent-writer head-change fault injection was run; head/CAS protections were reviewed in source
Local HMAC/manifest replicas and process reopen do not prove production key custody, external WORM or physical power-loss durability
No Linux/macOS release matrix, actual model/cost experiment or production promotion was run
